title: SHIELD: SUPPRESSING HALLUCINATIONS IN LVLM ENCODERS VIA BIAS AND VULNERABILITY DEFENSE

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the peak-to-average L2 norm ratio of visual tokens to evaluate overemphasis on frequent visual patterns and its correlation with object hallucination rates.

Evaluating the generation of erroneous representations of dominant objects by inputting meaningless noise images into the visual encoder and counting the hallucination occurrences of these objects using POPE-style evaluation.
